messages:
jen: Heads-up — opened PR #4827 that touches the on-prem KMS flow and the VPC egress rules. Need a security eyes-on and a quick merge window decision. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/4827

jen: Summary: switch to customer-managed KMS key handling (HSM-backed), add explicit egress allowlist for s3 and metrics endpoints, and a small authz change to the token minting path. No DB migrations.

mark: taking a look now. do we have a short repro or smoke test I can run locally?

jen: yep — added a smoke script in the PR description: 
```
./scripts/smoke_onprem_kms.sh --env local --key test-key
```
It runs a quick keywrap/unwrap and hits the metrics endpoint behind the egress rule.

sam: quick read — missing a unit test around the token mint path (edge case when key rotates). can add one in a follow-up but prefer it in this change if it's small.

jen: ok i can add it today. roughly how blocking is that for approve?

mark: not blocking for a security review, but ops wants merge timing aligned with maintenance window. security-wise I want a short checklist run: KMS perms, audit logging, and replay protection.

security-review-bot: automated scan results for PR #4827:
- secret scanning: no hardcoded secrets found :white_check_mark:
- IAM least-privilege check: WARNING — role allows kms:Encrypt on broader resource scope; recommend scoping to arn:aws:kms:::key/customer/*
- audit logs present: PASS
- crypto policy: PASS

security-review-bot: See details: https://sec-scans.internal/reports/4827

ops-lead: ops note — current maintenance window for on-prem deploys is Tue 14:00-15:30 PT. If we want minimal risk, plan to merge after a canary and during that window. Otherwise we should schedule an ad-hoc window.

jen: thanks. plan: i'll tighten the KMS IAM scope per the bot, add the unit test, push a small fixup. can we tentatively aim for Tue 14:15 PT canary + merge if green?

mark: sounds reasonable. I'll run the checklist once you push. If the IAM scope change is mechanical, I can approve once CI is green.

sam: rebase off main to pick up the infra lint fix, then add the test. ping me and i'll review the test quickly.

jen: done — pushed fixes at commit abc123 (refs in PR). changed IAM resource to scoped pattern, added unit test, rebased.

mark: running local smoke now. quick note: metrics endpoint host added to egress allowlist looks good. approving pending CI pass. :thumbsup:

sam: reviewed unit test and token rotations edge case — LGTM.

security-review-bot: re-scan complete: IAM warning resolved :white_check_mark:. No new issues detected.

ops-lead: scheduling canary at Tue 14:15 PT. please do a manual check of logs for the first 10 minutes.

jen: thanks all — scheduling merge for Tue 14:25 PT assuming canary green. i'll update the PR and add the post-merge checklist. :rocket:

mark: noted, will stand by for final CI.

sam: thanks — thanks for adding the test.

jen: merging after canary unless anyone objects in next 30m. otherwise i'll queue it.

mark: no objections from me.

sam: fine by me.

jen: merging after canary completed and logs checked. closing thread.
